# Vibecode

> > Vibecode is an AI-powered app builder that enables anyone to create mobile and web applications without coding experience, featuring wholesale AI credits from Anthropic and OpenAI.

Vibecode empowers indie developers and first-time creators to build production-ready apps for iOS and Android using AI-assisted development. The platform has enabled success stories like Daily Grid (a puzzle game) and Project Adulting (a personal finance app), demonstrating its capability to take users from zero to App Store.
